parts.scope: Purpose, priority population, eligibility, dates and award limits
parts.partners: Community input, related work and the roles of partners
parts.submission: Reusable proposal fields and award-specific supplements
parts.evaluation: Outcome definitions, review criteria and reporting
parts.reuse: Release of materials, methods, rights and privacy

criteria.call: Can a team tell whether its project qualifies, when to apply and what the award can cover?
criteria.application: Does the proposal identify the eligible population, project and fit with this call?

criteria.call: Does the call show how communities and other funders shaped it and how related efforts can work together?
criteria.application: Does the team identify related work, partner contributions and community decision-making?

criteria.call: Which existing proposal sections will the funder accept, and which supplements affect this award?
criteria.application: Can another donor reuse the project plan and distinguish this request from existing commitments?

criteria.call: Do allowable costs and award size support the reach, follow-up and maintenance requested?
criteria.application: Does the budget explain achievable reach, limitations and the cost of expansion?

criteria.call: Does the call explain how proposals will be judged and which outcome definitions and reports donors can share?
criteria.application: Are expectations, measures, timing and how results will be reported specific enough to check?

criteria.call: Does the call fund and require reusable materials, explicit rights, access to methods and privacy protections?
criteria.application: Does the proposal identify deliverables, reuse terms, a public home, and a safe level of data sharing?
